root.label: Greene-Placentia alleged attack in Sun City

events.label: Greene-Placentia alleged attack in Sun City

slots.name: attacker count
slots.sentence: Arizona Democratic congressional candidate Bernadette Greene-Placentia said she was knocked unconscious and raped during an overnight encounter with two attackers in August while trying to repair a damaged campaign sign.

slots.name: attack time
slots.sentence: Greene-Placentia told Phoenix New Times that she was walking through a parking lot in Sun City shortly after 2 a.m. on Aug. 14 to repair a damaged campaign sign when someone struck her in the head, knocking her unconscious.

slots.name: injury duration
slots.sentence: Greene-Placentia told Phoenix New Times she suffered extensive bruising and vaginal bleeding for three days after the alleged assault and believed she may have sustained a concussion.

slots.name: out of contact
slots.sentence: Greene-Placentia missed a campaign event and was out of contact with her staff for about two days following the alleged assault, according to The New York Times.

slots.name: police report date
slots.sentence: She later told campaign aides and her husband what happened before reporting it to police on Aug. 31, saying she initially felt embarrassed and wanted to forget the incident.
